name: GetClassDiagram
description: Generates a Mermaid class diagram for the types defined in a specific C# file, with options to discover inheritance and related types in the workspace.

filePath.description: Absolute path to the .cs file to analyze.

includeInheritance.description: Whether to search the workspace for base classes and interfaces.

includeDependencies.description: Whether to search for and include other classes used as properties or fields.

includeProperties.description: Whether to display properties and fields in the class diagram.

includeFunctions.description: Whether to display functions/methods in the class diagram.

depth.description: How many levels of relationships to follow.

showTitle.description: Whether to include the title in the diagram.
